text:
tasha: Heads-up — can we add a console affordance that shows why a request was routed to v1 vs v2? a tiny 'routing reason' pill would really speed up debugging.

anish: +1. we only show the final model today. not enough when rollouts act weird.

luisa: quick note — be careful about exposing internal decision trees to customers. internal console-only flag maybe? :thinking_face:

ben: agreed. first step is telemetry. propose event `routing.decision` with fields: tenant, request_id, decision, reason, latency, policy.

tasha: UX idea: show a small pill next to model like `route: v2 (header=client:legacy)` and on hover show the full trace + compact reason.

deploy-bot: deploy v2-routing-probe v0.3 -> prod in 3m :rocket:

anish: also need aggregated metrics: pct routed-by-policy, pct fallback, avg latency delta v2-v1, and time-to-converge.

sre-oncall: and make sure we have a one-click rollback action visible to SREs: `force-route v1` that hits the admin API. must be gated behind RBAC + 2FA.

luisa: privacy here — don't show internal IPs or sensitive config in the hover detail. redact anything with `ip`, `host`, or internal tags.

tasha: sample telemetry event (for discussion):
```json
{
  "event":"routing.decision",
  "tenant":"tenant_123",
  "request_id":"req_abc",
  "decision":"v2",
  "reason":"header_version=2",
  "latencies":{"v1":120,"v2":95},
  "probe_flags":["canary","latency_pref"]
}
```

ben: add `confidence_score` (float) and `cache_hit` (bool). also include `policy_version` so we can diff decisions across policy deploys.

anish: console UX: we should show the detailed 'why' only to internal users. customer-facing badge should be simplified to `auto / pinned / fallback`. keep the hover paste unobtrusive.

console-bot: Banner scheduled: "Routing insights beta" — click to opt-in for the new badges.

tasha: ok action items: 1) telemetry schema PR (ben) by EOD, 2) console mock (luisa) by Fri, 3) admin route + RBAC check (anish) POC by next Tue.

ben: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing-telemetry/pull/42 (placeholder)

luisa: mock uploaded: https://figma.internal/files/route-insights (placeholder)

sre-oncall: runbook snippet added to pagerduty doc, rollback example: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.internal/admin/route/force?model=v1` — will require ACL header.

deploy-bot: v2-routing-probe v0.3 deployed -> prod :white_check_mark:

tasha: thanks everyone — this should make canaries and compatibility breakages much easier to debug. :tada:
